critical_code_review_comments: HoleritePanel.js is ~1390 lines — same advice as iter68: split into smaller modules (HoleriteRow, HoleriteAIImportModal, AnomaliesModal).

Dynamic button state in MyHoleritesModal.js uses localStorage (per-device flag holerite_dl_{cid}_{docId}) — by design client-side. Be aware that the 'Enviar' state is lost if the user clears storage or switches device; user can simply re-press Baixar to re-trigger. Acceptable for current UX.
permanent_delete returns 200 even when filesystem unlink fails (best-effort try/except). Consider returning a partial-success warning when file unlink raises, for ops visibility.
